_README: Real observations captured from the live ROSPug on 2026-07-17 over rosbridge.
FIDELITY MATTERS — read `_fidelity` on each entry before using it as a fixture:
'exact'   = the literal value(s) observed, safe to assert against.
'summary' = we recorded aggregate stats, NOT the full raw array. Do not
fabricate the missing elements; generate synthetic arrays that
MATCH these stats instead, and keep them clearly synthetic.
The only full-fidelity payload we hold is the JPEG: rospug_frame_640x360.jpg

joint_states.note: 12 DOF confirmed. WARNING: every position read exactly 0.0, which is suspicious for a robot at rest. Strongly suspect servo readback requires publishing /ros_robot_controller/enable_reception = true first (same gotcha as TonyPi's board.enable_reception(True)). VERIFY before trusting these values as real angles.

imu.note: accel z ~= gravity, sane. Raw has no orientation fusion (w=0).

battery.note: 3S LiPo. Was at ~25% and DRAINING even with the charger attached (robot ON drew more than the 12.6V/2A charger supplies). 3.35 V/cell vs a 3.30 V/cell floor.

camera.known_fault: gscam started, published ~79s, then CLEANLY SELF-EXITED ('Cleaning up stream and exiting') while the rest of ROS kept running. Restarting it worked and it then stayed up >2min. Root cause UNKNOWN. A camera liveness watchdog is mandatory.
camera.web_video_server_note: CRITICAL: /snapshot and /stream BLOCK FOREVER (0 bytes, no HTTP response) when a topic is advertised but unpublished. The :8080 index still returns 200 in ~10ms, so the server looks healthy. Always use a timeout.

message_shapes._note: Field names and types read from rosapi/message_details on the live robot.

on_robot_paths._MISSED: We never copied /home/hiwonder/pug/src — it holds pug_control's real UNITS and LIMITS. scripts/grab_everything.sh fetches it first thing on next contact.
